content.title: Two big reasons to invest in founder-led businesses
content.description:
US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are rebounding from last week's losses and rallying ahead of Tuesday's closing bell. Intrepid Capital Co-Founder and CEO Mark Travis sits down with Josh Lipton to discuss why he prefers to invest in founder-led businesses, noting their ability to conservatively keep their balance sheets in order. One stock that Travis places in this category is SS&C Technologies Holdings (SSNC).
